com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote

Interface Quote.FieldItem

  • Enclosing class:
    Quote

    public static interface Quote.FieldItem
    A Quote contains collection of Quote.FieldItem. A FieldItem is composed of an Id, format and value. The JStandard Field Mappings page of https://developer.theice.com contains mappings of Field Id to LRT. These values are also defined as constants in Quote.FieldItem and are included in this javadoc below. Example, Quote.FieldItem.LRT_TYPE_BID is integer 20. Use these constants in your code to make your code more readable. New codes may be added in the future. API user can call "getValueAs" methods on Quote.FieldItem to get the data as primitive value. Example: getValueAsByte() API user can also call getValue() method to get the data as Object. When getFormat() doesn't align with "getValueAs*" method, calling the method will throw UnsupportedOperationException. When getFormat() doesn't align with "getValue()" method's return type T, calling the method will throw ClassCastException. It is recommended that API users follow the field id mapping documentation to avoid the exceptions.

    • Method Detail

      • getId

        short getId()
        Returns Id of the field. The JStandard Field Mappings page of https://developer.theice.com contains mappings of Field Id to LRT. These values are also defined as constants in Quote.FieldItem and are included in this javadoc below. For example, Quote.FieldItem.LRT_TYPE_BID is integer 20. Use these constants in your code to make your code more readable. New codes may be added in the future.
        Returns:
        id of the field

      • getFormat

        FIELDFORMAT getFormat()
        Returns format of the field.
        Returns:
        format of the field

      • getValueAsShort

        short getValueAsShort(boolean readAsUnsigned)
        Returns value of the field as short.

        The following FIELDFORMATs are supported. Calling this method with any other FIELDFORMAT will throw UnsupportedOperationException.

        • FIELDFORMAT.SHORT only when readAsUnsigned is false
        • FIELDFORMAT.BYTE
        It's recommended to only call this method when FIELDFORMAT is FIELDFORMAT.SHORT. Otherwise, you should call the appropriate getValueAs* method that returns a Java primitive.

        Parameters:
        readAsUnsigned - true specifies that the data should be treated as unsigned. false specifies that the data should be treated as signed.
        Returns:
        value of field as short
        Since:
        v1.20

      • getValueAsString

        void getValueAsString(java.lang.StringBuilder builder)
        Appends to a non null StringBuilder object passed in by user with the value of the field as a string. The user is responsible for setting and resetting the StringBuilders position. e.g. builder.setLength(0);

        When getFormat() is not FIELDFORMAT.STRING, calling the method will throw UnsupportedOperationException.

        The character set of the string is ISO-8859-1.

        Parameters:
        builder -
        Since:
        v1.20
